pages.title: File:VMCV Berna trolleybus 14 westbound on Rue du Simplon in Vevey, 1984 (ETH Com LC2384-003-019).jpg

ObjectName.value: VMCV Berna trolleybus 14 westbound on Rue du Simplon in Vevey, 1984 (ETH Com LC2384-003-019)

Categories.value: ETH-BIB Comet Photo AG|Cour au Chantre|Trolleybus route 201 Vevey–Montreux–Chillon–Villeneuve|Number 14 on trolleybuses|1984 photographs of Switzerland|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|1984 in the canton of Vaud|1984 in land transport in Switzerland|Berna trolleybuses|Vehicles in Vevey|Rue du Simplon (Vevey)

ImageDescription.value: Berna trolleybus 14 of the Montreux/Vevey trolleybus system (VMCV) was built in 1958. It is pictured westbound on Rue du Simplon at Rue du Centre in Vevey, on a trip to Vevey from Villeneuve. Trolleybus 14 was retired in 1995, and the last vehicles of its type were also retired around the end of 1995. The route number was 1 at this time, but was changed to "201" in 2010.
